evidence_snippets: From the pricing page , see the price in the column labeled Cost per node with 1-year committed use discounts to calculate the approximate hourly commitment cost: Expenditure in us-central1 : 10 nodes $0.52 per node per hour = $5.20 per hour Expenditure in us-west2 : 20 nodes $0.624 per node per hour = $12.48 per hour Total expenditure across all regions: $6.50 + $15.60 = $17.68 per hour ($12,906.40 per month or $154,876.80 per year).
Committed use discounts (CUDs) for Bigtable provide discounted prices in exchange for your commitment to continuously spend a minimum hourly amount on Bigtable capacity for a year or longer.
Important: This page explains the new and improved committed use discounts (CUDs) program, which applies to any customers who purchase their first CUDs on or after July 15, 2025 .
